name: Limits rest on evidence
ownerWords: i want daily duty to hunt for these and ferociously remove them aggressively
goal: No limit in auto-sns-agent rests on a guess. Every cap, ceiling, budget, throttle, timeout, backoff, retry count, batch size and concurrency setting cites a measurement, a vendor doc or an incident in the ledger, or it is gone with the code that served it. Each run removes every unbacked limit it finds.

metrics.label: Limit candidates with no verdict in the ledger
Unbacked limits found but still in the code
Kept limits with no evidence written
Unbacked money, send or ban limits waiting for the owner
Unbacked limits the last run found
Unbacked limits the last run removed
Ledger file that could not be read
Dropped limits whose name the code still uses

onMiss: Follow limits-evidence.md next to this precheck in sieun-pi components/user-history/scripts/duties/. Read the auto-sns-agent ledger apps/llm-wiki/content/domains/devops/limits-ledger.json first and write it last. Start one subagent per app with unjudged, unbacked or leftover candidates. A limit with no measurement, vendor doc or incident goes, with the code that only served it, unless it guards money, an outside send or a ban, which is the owner's call. Each drop is one commit, "chore(<app>): drop unbacked limit <name>", that also updates every caller, import, test and doc naming it, its env var or config key, found by a whole-repo search. Before the push, --leftovers lists nothing, and ruff, ty, tsc or svelte-check and the touched tests pass under nice -n 20. The subagent pushes the app's whole stack to ci/limits-<app>-<yymmdd> without --force and reports the run id. It joins the ops train only on that run's green. Send this chat the found, removed and kept counts as chat_board ops.
